maddeler.e:
تختلقون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِقُونَ (taḵtaliqūna) /tax.ta.li.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# تُخْتَلَقُونَ (tuḵtalaqūna) /tux.ta.la.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
